title: Weekly priorities talk
text: Hold a ten-minute talk at the start of each week where the manager names the top three tasks for each new hire and what can wait.

title: Written role checklist
text: Give each new hire a one-page list of their main tasks and who to ask, and walk through it together in the first week.

title: Short weekly one-to-one
text: Book a fifteen-minute one-to-one each week for the first three months, with one question: what is blocking you?

title: Named buddy
text: Name an experienced colleague as the buddy for every new hire's first month, for everyday questions.

title: Team lunch
text: Invite the new hire to eat with the team in the first two weeks and introduce them to each person by name.

title: Welcome round
text: On the first day, introduce the new hire to the whole team and share one thing each person can help with.

title: Training checklist
text: Make a checklist of the machines, systems and safety steps each new hire must be shown, and tick each one off with them.

title: Shadow then do
text: Pair the new hire with a trainer for each new task: watch once, do once with help, then do alone.

title: Workload check
text: Review the new hire's task list and hours together every two weeks, and move or drop work that does not fit.

title: Overtime limit
text: Agree a limit on overtime for new hires in the first three months and check it each week.

title: Update the job ad and the interview script for this role
text: Compare the job ad and the interview script with the real work on the line, rewrite what oversells the job, and agree the changes with the recruiter.
